title: material_selection
description: Phase 5 material choice + locked budget roll-up. transport_carbon_kgco2e is transport-only (recycled cut-off, manufacturing = 0, ASSUMED). solar_transmissivity is null for structural-only materials; a selected MEMBRANE must be non-null (is_membrane=true requires a number) so the Phase 5b (1 - tau) cooling correction is well-defined. selected_id must be one of the 10 frozen data/materials.json ids. v1.1.0 adds the availability-gate + recovery-reporting fields: selection_basis (the SORT KEY, always 'transport_carbon_min' — NEVER price; the honesty marker, hence required); availability_gated (D-06); cooling_correction_factor = (1 - tau), DERIVED, feeds Phase 5b — tau touches cooling ONLY, never cost/carbon; mass_balance (D-12, EXACT reserved field names from src/geom/geom.py); next_life (D-14 textile afterlife, ASSUMED placeholder, never a fabricated receiver); tent_comparison (D-13, exactly ONE ASSUMED-labelled ICE-cited baseline); infeasible (D-06: true => no available candidate).

allOf.$comment: A selected MEMBRANE must declare a non-null solar_transmissivity so the (1 - tau) cooling correction (Golden Rule, Phase 5b) is well-defined. Structural-only materials keep tau = null. The membrane-non-null guardrail is unit-tested in Phase 5.
